reason: A VS Code integration extension for launching and managing the local DeepSeek Harness web interface, with configurable in-editor or system-browser access.

summaries.zh: 在 VS Code 中打开 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，并为当前工作区启动或停止本地 dsh 服务。
summaries.en: Open the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in VS Code or a system browser while starting and stopping the local dsh service for the current workspace.

capabilities: Starts and stops the local dsh web service for the current workspace
Opens the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in a VS Code tab, Simple Browser, or system browser
Runs the configured dsh CLI and can use workspace patch files
Provides a script that may modify an installed DSH dependency on Windows
